exposure: Serum Creatine Kinase Muscle-Brain fraction (CK-MB) levels
cohort: The study included asphyxiated (cases) and non-asphyxiated (controls) term neonates from a tertiary care teaching hospital in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
finding: Elevated serum CK-MB levels at 8 and 24 hours and LDH levels were significantly higher in asphyxiated term neonates compared to controls and showed a significant correlation with stages of Hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy.
cross-section timing: CK-MB levels were measured at 8 hours and 24 hours after birth, and LDH levels were also measured.
